summary: Iteration 24 covers the vehicle-detail reorganisation (Submitted By at top, CarTrust row inside Order-a-VIN-Linked-Report at R200, admin pricing at bottom with two-step Alert) and the runtime dark/light theme toggle. Backend regression: 5/5 pytest tests pass — POST /api/admin/submissions/{id}/price persists price + price_history and GET returns status=priced; POST /api/kredo/cartrust/order is auth-protected (401 without bearer), returns 404 for unknown sub, 400 for missing VIN, and 200/pending or Kredo-error for a real submission. Frontend: (a) Admin vehicle detail — Submitted By card renders at the top (Y≈213px, immediately after reference badge) with dealer name, dealership, email, phone and Contact-on-WhatsApp button. Set Offer Price button + admin-pricing-inline live at the bottom of the scroll (Y≈3539). Priced submission FB-000093 was picked for the run — VIN was TBC so the Order-a-VIN-Linked-Report section (and CarTrust row) was correctly hidden. (b) Dealer login (minitest@example.com) has zero submissions, so a dealer view of a priced sub was not testable via the dealer session — but code path `{isAdmin && sub.dealer_name ? ...}` unambiguously gates the Submitted By card and `{isAdmin ? ...}` gates the admin pricing panel. (c) Theme toggle: both `theme-toggle-dark` and `theme-toggle-light` testIDs render on Profile → Appearance; clicking Day writes `light` to localStorage under key `fourbuy.themeMode`, and after a full page reload the value persists and the app re-renders in light mode (screenshots /tmp/23_light.png, /tmp/24_after_reload.png). Two issues found — see below.

ui_bugs.component: vehicle/[id].tsx — CarTrust row visibility for admin
ui_bugs.issue: Line 1597 renders the CarTrust row only when `!isAdmin || cartrust`. For an admin viewing a priced submission that has never had a CarTrust ordered (the common case), `cartrust` is null after `/api/kredo/cartrust/status` returns nothing, so the row (and its Order button) never appears. This blocks the P0 requirement that 'Admin taps Order on CarTrust row → confirmation modal appears → POST /api/kredo/cartrust/order'. Recommended: render the row unconditionally when the submission has a valid VIN, matching the review spec, or explicitly gate only the completed/pending states while always showing the Order CTA to admins. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(app)/vehicle/[id].tsx:1597.

ui_bugs.component: vehicle/[id].tsx — two-step Alert confirm on web
ui_bugs.issue: handleOfferPrice uses React Native's Alert.alert with Cancel/Confirm buttons. On the Expo web preview the buttons do not render (no `dialog` event fires and no Cancel/Confirm text is found in the DOM after tapping Confirm Price). The alert body text appears but the choice buttons are missing, so an admin cannot complete the two-step confirmation from the browser. Works on native but should either use a proper cross-platform Modal for the confirmation step, or a Platform.OS==='web' fallback using `window.confirm`. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(app)/vehicle/[id].tsx:440-473.

integration_issues.issue: Because the CarTrust row is hidden from admins with no existing report (see UI bug above), the end-to-end 'admin taps Order → POST /api/kredo/cartrust/order' could not be exercised from the UI. Backend endpoint itself was verified independently via pytest.

Two-step Alert confirmation cannot be completed on web because the Cancel/Confirm buttons of the RN Alert never render, blocking the /api/admin/submissions/{id}/price call from the UI. Backend endpoint itself is verified by pytest.

action_items: Fix CarTrust row visibility for admins in /app/frontend/app/(app)/vehicle/[id].tsx:1597 — condition `!isAdmin || cartrust` should not hide the Order CTA from admins. Render the row whenever VIN is valid; use `cartrust` only to switch between Order/View/pending states.

Replace or augment the Alert.alert two-step confirmation in handleOfferPrice (vehicle/[id].tsx:440) with a cross-platform confirmation UI (either a bespoke Modal or a Platform.OS==='web' branch using window.confirm) so the /api/admin/submissions/{id}/price POST can be reached from the web preview.
(Optional) Seed one priced submission owned by minitest@example.com so future testing passes can verify the dealer-view-hides-Submitted-By path end-to-end via UI.
critical_code_review_comments: vehicle/[id].tsx is 3419 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting price modal, CarTrust card, VIN report list, Kredo history and market-analysis blocks into their own components under /app/frontend/src/components/vehicle/. Same recommendation was made in earlier iterations.

REPORT_CATALOG mixes `ReportOrder['type']` with the special 'kredo_cartrust' string; the type assertion `(confirmReport.type as string) === 'kredo_cartrust'` (line 540) works but hides a real type mismatch. Consider widening `ReportOrder['type']` to include 'kredo_cartrust' or introducing a dedicated union type for the confirm modal payload.
The dependency array on the CarTrust polling effect (line 333) uses `cartrust?.status` — safe, but the interval will churn on every status transition. Fine at 8-second cadence but worth noting.

success_rate.frontend: 60% — Submitted By top card + WhatsApp + admin pricing placement at bottom + theme toggle (with persistence) all verified. CarTrust row admin visibility and Alert two-step confirmation on web could not be exercised due to the two bugs above.

rca_of_issue: 1) CarTrust row hidden for admin: intentional-looking guard `{(!isAdmin || cartrust) ? ...}` mirrors the pattern used for other VIN reports where admins are read-only. But CarTrust has a distinct admin-can-order requirement per the P0 spec, and that guard blocks it. Fix by removing the admin arm of the guard and letting the button's own status branch (pending / completed / order) handle the UI states. 2) Alert two-step confirm on web: react-native-web's Alert.alert polyfill renders as a native browser alert with only OK — multi-button Alerts on web silently drop the extra options, so the 'Confirm price' handler is never invoked from the browser. Standard fix is a small Platform.OS check that uses window.confirm on web (returns boolean) or a bespoke confirmation Modal component that works on all platforms.
